Feature: Identification and utilization of information by Hospital Staff
  Background: When the Hospital Staff has access to the system
    Background: Given the system is accessible and comprehensible

    # Test case 1: Retrieve patient information
    Scenario: Hospital Staff identifies patient information
    Given I have access to the system and I am ready to retrieve information
    When I request patient data
    Then the system should retrieve patient information as an array

    # Test case 2: State requirements
    Scenario: Hospital Staff states the requirements
    Given I have access to the system and I am ready to state requirements
    And I provide the necessary details
    Then the system should display the requirements as an array

    # Test case 3: Provide feedback
    Scenario: Hospital Staff provides feedback
    Given I have access to the system and I am ready to provide feedback
    And I submit my feedback
    Then the system should request feedback as an array

    # Test case 4: Use as a reference document
    Scenario: Hospital Staff uses the document as a reference
    Given I have access to the system and I am ready to use it as a reference
    And I review the document
    Then the system should be accessible and comprehensible as an array

    # Test case 5: System flags input for review
    Scenario: System flags input for review
    Given I have access to the system and the input is ready for review
    When the input is flagged for review
    Then the system should flag the input as an array

    # Test case 6: View the complete document
    Scenario: Hospital Staff views the complete document
    Given I have access to the system and I view the complete document
    Then the system should display the complete document as an array

    # Test case 7: Confirm design
    Scenario: Hospital Staff confirms the design
    Given I am ready to confirm the design
    When I confirm the design
    Then the system should confirm the design meets specifications as an array

    # Test case 8: Identify and request revisions
    Scenario: Hospital Staff identifies issues and requests revisions
    Given I am ready to identify issues and request revisions
    And I am ready to confirm the design
    When I request design confirmation
    Then the system should identify issues and request revisions as an array
```

The "preconditions" in the JSON objects are not explicitly stated as they are implied in the Gherkin scenarios. If additional preconditions are needed, they should be added to the "Given" step in the corresponding Gherkin scenario.
